greeting: Right, Inspector. {Victim}, dead. Let's get on with it, shall we?
Ask what you like. I'll answer straight. That's more than you'll get from some aboard.
Good God. {Victim.full}. I was talking to {victim.object} only this afternoon.
Don't dawdle, Inspector. Whoever did this is still on the ship, and I've a tournament on Thursday.
Sit down, then. And don't treat me as though I'm about to faint. I've never fainted in my life.
Dreadful business. Rotten, unsporting business. Fire away.
whereabouts: {Time} I was {room}. Write it down and move on.
{RoomName}, {time}. I don't go in for fuss.
I was {room} {time}, Inspector. No mystery there.
{Time}, {room}. Straight answer to a straight question.
sawOne: I saw {other}. {Other.subject} saw me too, so don't bother trying to catch me out.
There was {other}. I'd have preferred my own company, frankly.
Only {other}. Gave {other.object} a nod. Fair enough?
sawSeveral: {Others} were there. Too much chatter for my liking.
There were {others}. Like a club lawn on a bank holiday.
{Others}. None of them any use as witnesses, I shouldn't think.
Oh, {others}. All getting under my feet.
sawVictim: {Victim} was there. Large as life. Hard to believe.
I saw {victim}. {Victim.subject} looked perfectly fine. Fit as a fiddle.
{Victim}, yes. We had words. Not that kind of words. Ordinary words.
Yes, I saw {victim}. Wish I'd stuck closer, now.
{Victim} was there. If I'd known, I'd have done something. I'm not the sort to stand by.
I saw {victim}, alive and well. That's the last time I'll ever say that, isn't it.
sawNoOne: Nobody. I like a bit of peace before a match.
Not a soul. Don't look at me like that.
No one. And before you ask, no, I can't prove it.
Nobody at all. Is that a foul now?
I saw no one. Quiet as a lawn at dawn.
confrontCrack: {Witness} said that? Fine. Fair cop. Here's the truth, then.
Blast. All right, Inspector. You've got me bang to rights.
{Witness} always did have sharp eyes. Very well. I'll come clean.
Oh, for heaven's sake. Yes, all right. It's not what you think, though.
confrontDeflect: {Witness} is wrong. Flat wrong. I've said where I was.
I don't care what {witness} says. My answer stands.
Impertinent. I won't dignify that. Next question.
{Witness} needs spectacles. I'm not changing a word.
accusedWrongly: Me? With {weapon}? I'd have used a mallet, and I'd have done it in front of everyone.
That's a foul, Inspector, and you know it. I didn't kill {victim}.
Rubbish. I play fair. Always have. Ask anyone.
Say that again and I'll have you off the lawn. I'm innocent, and I'll prove it.
accusedRightly: {Victim} knew about my wrist, Inspector. {Victim.subject} was going to tell the tournament committee. I couldn't let that happen.
All right. {Weapon}. I don't miss, Inspector. Never have.
Game over, then. Yes, it was me. {RoomName}, and I'll not snivel about it.
You've played a better game than I did. {Victim.subject} pushed me too far. That's all I'll say.
opinion.marble: {Other}? Pompous bully. Clever, though. I'll give {other.object} that.
{Other.subject} thinks a woman with a mallet is a vulgar spectacle. I think a man in that waistcoat is.
I enjoy needling {other}. It's the only decent sport aboard.
opinion.folder: {Other}? Fusspot. Gave me the worst cabin on the deck and wrote me a receipt for it.
{Other.subject} quotes regulations at you like a referee with no game to referee.
I've complained to {other} three times. I'll make it four before New York.
opinion.bear: {Other} mothers me. Suffocating. I'm rather fond of {other.object}, actually.
{Other.subject} wants me in a frock. Pink, for preference. Over my dead body.
{Other} talks enough for six. Kind heart, though. Kindest aboard.
opinion.egg: {Other} needs fresh air and a backbone. I'm working on both.
Nice girl, {other}. Jumps at {other.possessive} own shadow. I keep telling {other.object} to stand up straight.
Anyone who bullies {other} answers to me.
opinion.pail: {Other} rigged me up a practice lawn on deck. Best man on this ship.
I trust {other}. Only person aboard I do.
{Other.subject} sees everything and says half of it. That's the right ratio.
eulogy.marble: {Other}. Can't say I liked {other.object}. Can't say {other.subject} deserved this, either.
We sparred every day. I'll miss the sparring. Not {other.object}. The sparring.
{Other.subject} was clever. Cleverer than {other.subject} let on. Somebody was cleverer still.
eulogy.folder: {Other}. Fusspot. Harmless fusspot. Dash it all.
I complained about {other.object} three times. Feel a bit of a cad about it now.
{Other.subject} never did anything without a form. Hope someone fills one out for {other.object} properly.
eulogy.bear: {Other.subject} wanted to see me married. Said {other.subject}'d dance at the wedding. Damn.
{Other.subject} fussed over me like a mother hen. I'd give my best mallet to be fussed over once more.
eulogy.egg: {Other}? That poor kid. I was supposed to be looking out for {other.object}.
{Other.subject} never hurt a fly. Whoever did this, I want them, Inspector.
I kept telling {other.object} to toughen up. Wasn't {other.possessive} fault, was it.
eulogy.pail: {Other}. {Other.subject} built me a lawn on a ship. Who does that?
Best man aboard. Find who did this, Inspector, or I will.
I trusted {other.object}. I don't trust many. Now it's one fewer.
